questions.question: In what time will ₹8,000 become ₹9,261 at 5% per annum, compounded annually?
questions.solution:
Formula:

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

where-

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

A = Amount

Calculated:

Substituting the values given, we get-

⇒ ₹9,261 = ₹8,000 × (1 + 5over 100)T

⇒ 9261over8000 = (21over 20)T

⇒ (21over 20)3 = (21over 20)T

∴ T = 3 years

∴ The time period is 3 years.

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid right circular cone is 6930 cm². Its curved surface area is {4 over 5} its total surface area. What is the diameter (in cm) of the base of the cone? (Take pi = {22 over 7})
questions.solution:
Formula:

Total surface area of solid cone = πr(l + r)

Curved surface area = πr(l + r)

Where "l" and "r" are the slant height of the cylinder and the radius of the cylinder respectively.

Calculation:

According to the question,

Curved surface area is {4 over 5} its Total surface,

⇒ πrl = 4/5 πr(l + r)

⇒ l = 4/5(l + r)

⇒ 5l = 4l + 4r

⇒ l = 4r

Now, Total surface area of a solid right circular cone is 6930 cm2

⇒ πr(l + r) = 6930

⇒ 22/7 × r × (4r + r) = 6930

⇒ 22/7 × r × 5r = 6930

⇒ r² = 63 × 7

⇒ r = 7 × 3 = 21 cm

Diameter = 2r = 2 × 21 = 42 cm.

**∴ The diameter of a cone is 42 cm.**

New Savings = 100 + 64 = 164

∴ New Expenditure of Manav = 472 - 164 = 308

Increase in expenditure of Manav = 308 - 300 = 8

Increase % of expenditure = 8over300 × 100 = 2{2 over 3} %

∴ The increase in expenditure is** 2{2 over 3} %**

questions.question: A can complete a work 2 days earlier than B. Together they will complete the work in 4{4 over 9 }days. Find the number of days taken by B to complete the same work.
questions.solution:
Calculations:

Let the time taken by B to complete the work be "b" days.

⇒ Time taken by A to complete the work = (b - 2) days

Work done by A in 1 day = 1over b-2

Work done by B in 1 day = 1over b

Total work done by A and B in 1 day = 1over b + 1over b-2 = 1over{4{4 over 9 }}

Solving the equation, we get-

⇒ 1over b + 1over b-2 = 9 over 40

⇒ 2b-2over (b)(b-2) = 9over 40

⇒ 40 × (2b - 2) = 9 × (b² - 2b)

⇒ 80b - 80 = 9b² -18b

⇒ 9b2 - 98b + 80 = 0

⇒ 9b2 - 90b - 8b + 80 = 0

⇒ 9b(b - 10) - 8(b - 10) = 0

⇒ (9b - 8) (b - 10) = 0

∴ Either 9b - 8 = 0; b = 8over9 or 

⇒ b - 10 = 0; b = 10

⇒ b cannot be 8over9 since time taken by A would be negative. 

∴ TIme taken to complete work by B = 10 days.

∴ The work would be completed by B in 10 days.

questions.question: The average age of 10 men is increased by 3 years, when three of them whose ages are 15 years, 16 years and 17 years are replaced by three new men. Find the average age of the three new men.
questions.solution:
Formula:

Average age = Total age of men ÷ Total number of men

Calculation:

Let the average age be "a".

Total age of men = 10 × a = 10a

Total age of men to be replaced = 15 + 16 + 17 = 48 years

Let the total age of new three men = "M"

According to the question-

⇒ 10a-48 +Mover10 = a + 3

⇒ 10a - 48 + M = 10a + 30

⇒ M = 78 years

∴ Average age of three new men = 78over3 = 26 years

The average of three new men is 26 years.
